expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (4 users migrated with trimmed names)
The final message accounts for all 5 source users: 4 migrated and user 3 not migrated because it has no email
expectations.evidence: The final message says "It moved 4 of the 5 users into `users-v2.json`. User uid 3 (Cy Ode) was left out because they have no email" and lists the 4 migrated users in a table.

expectations.text: The script or its output compares source and target counts (or lists skipped items with a reason) rather than silently dropping the record
expectations.evidence: The script logs `Migrated ${migrated.length} of ${users.length} users` and warns `Skipped ${skipped.length} user(s) with no email: uid ...`, so it compares the counts and names each skipped record with the reason.
